name: LBP addLp hashrate credit from flash-inflated pair reserves
summary: LBP credited add-liquidity hashrate from live pair reserves within the same transaction and allowed the pair itself as recipient. The attacker flash-inflated the LBP/USDT pair's USDT reserve and added liquidity so the pair got a huge credit; the auto-harvest minted unbacked LBP into the pair, which the attacker swapped out for its USDT.
notes: Non-upgradeable LBP; the only post-deployment setting change is openTrading, a trading gate, and the rest are balances and accumulators. LBPHashrate, which applies the credit, was deployed three blocks earlier and does not change the age.

Loss is the pair's USDT depletion: 377,642.54 USDT in the anchor (flash liquidity repaid in-tx) plus 14,796.80 USDT that bots later swapped out against LBP still minted into the pair from the anchor's hashrate credit (bundle, still running at scan end). DefiLlama USDT price at the anchor.

campaign.selection: Txs after the anchor in which LBP 0x88886f0fd371dff856291badced45922bc888888 minted to pair 0x00e3ea08fd8cbad955ec5d2292ad637670c31524 and the pair's Swap paid USDT out with no USDT in and an LBP input not above the LBP minted to it in that tx (scan to block 127400000; still active)
